methods.description: For a given10,100or1000, move every digit the indicated number of columns left for multiplication or right for division, preserving needed zeros. Use this same method for word problems and correcting wrong directions/counts.
Compare the given place-value positions to choose missing powers or complete a two-operation sentence; reverse given scale operations in opposite order to find the starting number, then check.
